source: Gemini 3.8 Flash (agy), targeted listening on short clips of the official video audio, captions excluded; 2026-10-21. Same model as recheck-gemini.json: one witness, not two.

places.question: Which Arabic lines are sung here, and in what order? Are the shown lines arabic-said-1 and arabic-said-2 what is sung?
places.answer: Only one Arabic line is sung: 'مُنَعَّمٌ وَخَالِدٌ' (arabic-32). The shown lines arabic-said-1 and arabic-said-2 are NOT sung; they are incorrect Arabic misattributions for the Persian verses of Rumi sung here: 'گفتا که شیخی و سری' and 'پیش‌رو و پیش‌گهی'.

places.question: Is the Persian beit «گفت که شیخی و سری پیشرو و راهبری» sung before the reply «شیخ نیم پیش نیم امر تو را بنده شدم»? When does each half start? How many times is «امر تو را بنده شدم» sung?
places.answer: No, the Persian line «گفت که شیخی و سری پیشرو و راهبری» is not sung at all. Only the reply is sung: its first half («شیخ نیم پیش نیم») starts at ~372.6 s («شیخ نیم» at 372.6 s, «پیش نیم» at 374.5 s), and its second half («امر تو را بنده شدم») starts at ~376.6 s. The phrase «امر تو را بنده شدم» is sung exactly twice (376.6–381.4 s and 381.4–385.9 s), followed by an instrumental interlude with no further vocals in the clip.

places.question: Is «امر تو را بنده شدم» sung again here, or is it instrumental?
places.answer: It is instrumental; the phrase is not sung here.

places.question: How many times is «في رحلة الفنون» sung, and when?
places.answer: Sung twice: first by the soloist at 300.4–302.4 s, and repeated immediately by the ensemble at 302.4–304.5 s.

places.question: How many times is «مبتعد تعبان» sung, and when?
places.answer: Sung twice consecutively by the vocalist: first from 318.4 to 320.3 s, and repeated immediately from 320.4 to 322.4 s.

places.question: Is the shown line arabic-14 sung here? What exactly is sung?
places.answer: Yes, line arabic-14 (قَدْ قِيلَ لِي خَبِيثٌ) is sung here.

places.question: How many times is «بل خادم مطيع» sung, and when?
places.answer: The phrase «بل خادم مطيع» is sung 3 times consecutively by Sami Yusuf between 336.9 s and 342.8 s.

places.question: Is the line sung here Persian or Turkish? Write exactly what is sung.
places.answer: The line sung here is Turkish: 'Aşk devleti gelince ben'. It is not Persian and does not match the website's shown line dowlat-2.

places.question: In the line with «روشن» and «بخشنده», is the conjunction «و» sung between them?
places.answer: Yes, the conjunction «و» is sung between «روشن» and «بخشنده» («روشن و بخشنده شدم»).

segments.heard: از ملک و ملک و ملک

places.question: How many times is «نور پذیرنده» sung, and when?
places.answer: «نور پذیرنده» is sung 2 times (both times as the full line «نور پذیرنده شدم»): first by the choir at 449.9–451.6 s (matches rumi-16-2b), and immediately repeated solo by Sami Yusuf at 451.7–453.8 s (repeat not in shown lines, matches NONE). From 453.9 s onwards, the song proceeds to «شکر کند چرخ فلک» (rumi-17-1).

places.question: Is this the Arabic coda (shown lines coda-ar-3, coda-ar-4) or «فرخ و فرخنده»? Write exactly what is sung.
places.answer: This is the Arabic coda (including lines coda-ar-3 and coda-ar-4), not «فرخ و فرخنده».

places.question: Write the sung lines in order with times: which are Arabic, Turkish, Persian? Where is Persian «دولت» sung?
places.answer: The stretch begins with Arabic (522.0–523.3 s, end of «مُنَعَّمٌ وَخَالِدٌ»), followed by Turkish (523.4–546.7 s: «Bir ölüydüm canla doldum», «Ağlar idim gülüş oldum», and two cycles of «Aşk devleti gelince ben / Sonsuzluk devleti buldum»), and ends with Persian (546.8–566.0 s: two cycles of «دولت عشق آمد و من / دولت پاینده شدم»). Persian «دولت» is sung only from 546.8 s to 566.0 s (coda-fa-5 through coda-fa-8); the preceding lines (523.4–546.7 s) shown as coda-fa-a through coda-fa-4 on the website are actually sung in Turkish.

places.question: Are there any words sung here, or is it wordless vocalising? If words, which?
places.answer: Wordless vocalising only; no words are sung.

places.question: How many times is «اختر رخشنده شدم» sung, and when exactly?
places.answer: «اختر رخشنده شدم» is sung twice: first from 468.1 s to 471.0 s, and repeated from 471.0 s to 473.9 s.
